# Lucide icons

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Pinned distribution: lucide-static@0.468.0 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide-static/v/0.468.0).

Only the SVG subset used by the dashboard is vendored. See LICENSE for ISC and inherited MIT notices. No runtime CDN requests. SVG geometry is unmodified; build.js embeds the inner shapes into the accessible UI wrapper.
